heading: Automation of Food and Drug Administration

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary, acting through the Commissioner of Food and Drugs, shall automate appropriate activities of the Food and Drug Administration to ensure timely review of activities regulated under this chapter.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated each fiscal year such sums as are necessary to carry out this section.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 711 of act June 25, 1938, was renumbered section 731 by Pub. L. 102–571 and is classified to section 379f of this title.

ancestors.heading: FEDERAL FOOD, DRUG, AND COSMETIC ACT
